About Project IRIS Project IRIS develops AI-supported spatial resilience and geospatial data models for the energy transition. To breathe dynamic life into our static infrastructure data, we integrate global earth observation data into our central inference engine. In this role, you will add the dimension of real-time surface activity and physical states to our spatial intelligence models. 

Your Focus & Responsibilities 

- Satellite Pipelines: Build automated pipelines to fetch and process Sentinel-1 (Radar/InSAR) and Sentinel-2 (Multispectral) data via the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem. 
- Algorithm Development: Develop algorithms to automatically detect surface changes, vegetation decline, moisture indices (NDVI/NDWI), and thermal anomalies. 
- Data Integration: Seamlessly integrate derived raster metadata and Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs (COG) into our central PostGIS vector database. 

What We Are Looking For 

- Technical Background: Degree in Remote Sensing, Geoinformatics, Data Science, Physics, or equivalent practical industry experience.  
- Core Technical Skills: Deep practical experience in processing satellite data (Landsat, Sentinel) using Python libraries such as Rasterio, xarray, or GDAL. 
- Mindset: An analytical mindset capable of deriving tangible ecological, thermal, and structural factors from raw pixel values. 
- Eligibility: Open to local applicants and international candidates (Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card supported).  
- Languages: Professional working proficiency in English (required); German language skills are a plus.

jobs.occupation: 588035 Factory Project Manager (all genders) (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description:
As Project Manager BBN Factory, you will join the production and operations network of Philips' HPM manufacturing site in Böblingen and work closely with PIE, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Facility Management and the shop floor. In this high-impact role, you will translate strategic industrialization objectives into operational execution, ensuring the successful and timely introduction of new products in an international environment. As a central coordinator between local and global stakeholders, you will directly contribute to the sustainable development and future readiness of the Böblingen site.

You will take end-to-end ownership of complex, production-related projects within the BBN Factory environment, ensuring on-time industrialization and new-product introduction. Acting as the key interface between Product Industrialization Engineering (PIE), Production Process Engineering, the shop floor and other Operations functions, you will coordinate production-line setups, machinery and system implementations, and cross-site initiatives—playing a decisive role in achieving critical NPI milestones.

This is an opportunity to shape how innovative patient-monitoring solutions move from industrialization into reliable production, influence a broad international stakeholder network and leave a visible, lasting impact on Philips' global manufacturing organization.

Please note: This is a fixed-term employment contract for 24 months.

Your Role:

- Job title:End-to-End Project Management: Plan, manage and execute multiple parallel production and industrialization projects in a manufacturing environment, including schedule, resource, cost and risk management.
- Interface & Stakeholder Management: Closely coordinate between PIE, Production Process Engineering, the shop floor, Facility Management, material supply, logistics, Production Management and operator resource management.
- QMS & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and Quality Management System processes, particularly in the medical-technology environment, and create, maintain and secure approval of relevant production-side project and process documentation.
- Supplier & Partner Management: Manage relevant internal and external project partners and work closely with Calibration, Maintenance and Technical Support teams.
- International Project Coordination: Lead and coordinate international projects across multiple HPM locations, particularly programs involving several sites within a global matrix organization.

You're the right fit if:

- You have a bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations, industrial management, or a related field.
- You have at least 5 years of experience leading manufacturing or industrialization projects across multiple workstreams.
- You have experience with quality systems and compliance in a regulated sector.
- You have practical knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, and structured project management.
- You have experience coordinating global, cross-functional teams.
- You understand production processes, equipment, robotics, and NPI.
- You are able to influence without authority and drive actions.
- You have business-level German and fluent English, both spoken and written.
- You are able to deliver NPI, quality, and production-readiness milestones.
- You collaborate effectively across factory and operational functions.

Benefits include:

- Annual leave: 30 days
- Mobility and devices: subsidized Germany ticket, leasing opportunities for private use (bicycles, cars, smartphones,…)
- Philips University & Philips in Balance: Wide range of professional training courses and for personal development & Healthcare
- Philips Pension Fund: Employer-funded pension plan
- Philips "Partnerzeit": two paid weeks off after your partner has given birth
- Philips MyShop: Discount on Philips products
- Culture: Informal culture, a paid day for voluntary work, various team/cultural activities (on sustainability, diversity, ...), etc.

Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. The base salary range for this role is €103,510.62 – €138,014.16. We determine pay within the range using objective factors, like the skills the role requires, your relevant experience and the responsibility you'll have in this role, alongside internal equity and local market considerations.

This role is eligible for Short Term Incentive, with your rewards linked to individual performance and company results. We’ll share the full approach with you during the interview process, so you can make a clear, informed decision.

How we work together
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities.

About Philips
Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business (https://www.philips.com/a-w/about.html) , discover our rich and exciting history (https://www.philips.com/a-w/about/our-history.html) and learn more about our purpose (https://www.philips.com/a-w/about/environmental-social-governance/our-purpose) .

jobs.occupation: Electrical Drive & Controls Engineer (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
Help Accelerate Industrial Decarbonization

Join exceptional people from around the world to solve some of the world's toughest energy challenges, make a real impact, and enjoy the adventure of building the future of industrial decarbonization together.

As our Electrical Drive & Controls Engineer, you'll help bring our solar thermal technology to life by developing, integrating, testing, and maintaining the electrical drive and control systems behind our innovative collector technology.

Working alongside Mechanical, Structural and Software Engineers, you'll play a hands-on role in building prototypes, developing test benches, integrating electrical hardware with control software, and validating new solutions before they are deployed in industrial-scale projects.

Your Impact

The systems you build and test will directly improve the reliability, performance, and efficiency of GlassPoint's solar thermal technology.

By combining practical engineering with close collaboration across disciplines, you'll help ensure our innovations perform reliably in the laboratory, during testing, and ultimately in the field.

What You'll Do

Build & Integrate Electrical Systems

- Support the development and integration of electrical drive systems for our solar thermal technology.
- Install, wire, commission, and maintain electrical and control components for prototypes and engineering test benches.
- Troubleshoot electrical systems and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Support Controls & Software Development

- Work closely with software and controls engineers to develop and validate drive and control systems.
- Integrate electrical hardware with control software for prototypes and test benches.
- Support commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimization of drive and control systems during testing.
- Assist with functional testing and validation to ensure reliable system performance.

Develop and Maintain Test Systems

- Design, build, install, and maintain electrical systems for engineering test benches supporting the development and validation of our solar thermal components and subsystems.
- Prepare and execute functional testing of electrical drives, control systems, and other electromechanical components.
- Analyse test results and recommend improvements to system performance and reliability.

Collaborate Across Engineering

- Work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams to solve technical challenges.
- Support prototype assembly, commissioning, and field testing where required.
- Contribute to technical documentation, engineering standards, and continuous product improvement.

Who You Are

You're someone who enjoys getting hands-on with hardware and solving practical engineering challenges. You like building, wiring, testing, troubleshooting, and continuously improving electrical systems, and you're comfortable working both in the workshop and alongside multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Ideally, you'll bring:

- A degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline.
- 5+ years of experience developing, integrating, and testing electrical drive and control systems in an industrial environment.
- Hands-on experience wiring, commissioning, troubleshooting, and validating electrical equipment and test systems.
- Experience integrating electrical hardware with control software; experience developing or modifying basic control software is an advantage.
- Experience with PLCs, servo drives, motion control systems, or industrial automation.
- The ability to read electrical schematics and technical drawings.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a practical, structured approach.
- Fluency in English; German is an advantage.
- Willingness to travel occasionally to suppliers and project sites.

What You'll Find at GlassPoint

- Meaningful responsibility from day one and the opportunity to make a real impact.
- Exceptional colleagues from diverse disciplines who challenge, support, and learn from each other.
- Complex engineering challenges that require curiosity, collaboration, and innovation.
- A highly collaborative environment where your work moves quickly from concept to real-world application.
- Opportunities to grow your technical expertise through cross-functional projects and international collaboration.
- The adventure of helping build the future of industrial decarbonization.

At GlassPoint, we believe that different perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our teams. We are committed to providing an inclusive working environment where everyone is treated with respect, feels valued, and has the opportunity to contribute their best work.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, ethnic or social background, nationality, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We have zero tolerance for discrimination, harassment, bullying, or retaliation.

GlassPoint helps heavy industry decarbonize by replacing fuel-based steam with solar thermal heat. This reduces energy costs and improves long-term energy security.  We’re a proven technology, already operating some of the world’s largest solar steam projects across sun-belt regions in oil and gas, metals, and mining.

jobs.occupation: Senior HR Administration Specialist – Compensation & Payroll (m/f/d) (Lohn- und Gehaltsbuchhalter/in)
jobs.description:
TYTAN Technologies

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty. We're looking for a Senior HR Administration Specialist with deep expertise in compensation and payroll to build the strategic and operational backbone TYTAN’s compensation plan

This is not a purely administrative role. You'll be the internal expert on compensation structure, payroll accuracy, and benefits strategy, running a flawless day-to-day payroll operations, you will also act as a key point of contact for employees, managers, HR, Finance, and external payroll providers, ensuring payroll and compensation data is accurate, processes are well controlled, and employee queries are resolved efficiently. This role is ideal for someone strong payroll expertise with excellent attention to detail, analytical skills, and a service-oriented approach.

Your Roadmap to make an Impact

Compensation Strategy & Benchmarking

- Build and maintain TYTAN's salary benchmarking framework, ensuring pay ranges are competitive, internally consistent, and grounded in real market data
- Design a scalable compensation model and leveling approach that can support TYTAN's growth over the next several years, not just its current headcount
- Continuously benchmark and compare benefits offerings against market standards, recommending adjustments to stay competitive as TYTAN scales
- Partner with leadership on compensation decisions for new hires, promotions, and salary reviews, bringing data-backed recommendations rather than ad hoc judgment calls

Payroll Operations

- Own end-to-end monthly payroll processing in coordination with external payroll providers/tax advisors, ensuring accuracy and on-time delivery
- Maintain and update employee master data relevant to payroll and compensation (contracts, salary changes, benefits, terminations, parental leave, etc.)
- Ensure full payroll compliance with German labor law, tax regulations, and social security requirements

Benefits

- Own TYTAN's benefits offering end-to-end administration, employee communication, and ongoing evaluation against market benchmarks
- Identify and recommend new or improved benefits as part of the broader compensation strategy

Tools, Process & Reporting

- Evaluate, implement, and/or optimize HR/payroll systems to support compensation and payroll processes as TYTAN scales
- Prepare reports and analytics on payroll costs, compensation trends, and benefits utilization for People Ops, Finance, and leadership
- Support internal and external audits related to payroll and compensation
- Build and document scalable compensation and payroll processes, since much of this infrastructure is still being established at TYTAN

Job requirements

- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
- 5+ years of relevant experience in HR administration, payroll, compensation, or a similar role.
- Strong hands-on experience with end-to-end payroll processes.
- Experience working with HRIS and payroll systems; Datev is a plus.
- Good understanding of compensation principles and payroll-related legislation.
- Strong Excel skills, including data analysis, reconciliations, and reporting.
- Experience working with confidential and sensitive employee information.
- Experience coordinating with Finance, payroll providers, and other internal/external stakeholders.
- Fluency in German and English is required

Why TYTAN?

- Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security
- Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale
- Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors
- Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback
- Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact
- Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company
- Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

- Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through Virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation
- Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit
- Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us
- Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team
- Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together
- Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands
- Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

You'll work closely with Electrical, Product, Reliability, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain teams. - Own the electromechanical design of injection-molded plastics, sheet metal, high-pressure die castings, heat sinks / cold plates, insulation systems, magnetics, HV/LV interconnects, busbars, and PCBA-adjacent structures

- Direct experience in power electronics packaging: inverters, chargers, DC-DC, magnetics, busbars, or HV semiconductor modules

- Hands-on lab instinct: you would rather instrument a prototype than argue from a slide
